legend-crown-range-road.slogan: Crown Range Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-crown-range-road.story: New Zealand's highest sealed road, Queenstown to Wanaka. 58 km from Queenstown to Wanaka, about 1 h 03 of riding. The highest point is about 1,100 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Crown Range Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 8 km this is Crown Range Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
